title: Replicating Quirky-Model ELK Probes as a Sandbagging Detector on Open Models

original_idea.body: Quirky-Model ELK Probes as Sandbagging Detector

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: sandbagging detection is a recognized eval-integrity/ELK pathway; concrete detector deliverable.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Reuses public elk repos + logistic-regression probes; guided, no large-model training.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (probe-vs-output disagreement AUROC as sandbagging signal).

low_compute.reasoning: Activation probes on open chat model; modest GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Quirky-model probes exist; transfer to off-the-shelf sandbagging detection may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Probes exist; sandbagging-transfer angle may be open.
